title: Planning team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/planning.yaml: the team layer of the planning plugin's settings. A value here overrides the same key in the plugin's userConfig. Contract: docs/adr/0064-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

plan_store.description: Where /planning:plan keeps an approved plan. local: PLAN.md in the memory slice only. tracker: also posted as one marked comment on the claimed work item, updated in place on re-publish.

phase_order.description: How /planning:plan orders phases. composed: remove dead code the change touches (skipped for a bug fix), then the integration slice, then the riskiest remaining unknown, then scaffold, then the remaining features. subtraction-first: dead code, scaffold, features. riskiest-first: the step whose failure would invalidate the most downstream work goes first.

scaffold_stubs.description: When true, /planning:design hands off the stub files the change needs with their signatures, and /planning:plan places a stub phase right after phase_order's dead-code removal step (first when there is none). Stub bodies use the language's ordinary not-implemented form. A quoted "true" or "false" is a string, not a boolean, and is invalid.

shared_session.description: Starting settings for a /planning:interview shared session. Read once, when a session's state is first created; the owner changes a running session from its Host view.

uploads.description: Whether guests may offer files. The owner still accepts each one.

names.description: What guests see of who answered and voted. full: names. initials: initials and vote counts, never voter ids. someone: guests see "Someone". The owner and leaders always see names.

digest_names.description: Whether the round sent to Claude names who answered, except people a question is aimed at, who are always named.

claude_take.description: When people see Claude's suggestion cards. answer-first: after they answer or vote. always: at once. Each person can switch for themselves.

signoff.description: Whether a leader's lock needs everyone's agreement first. The owner's lock never does.

chat.description: Whether the side chat is on. Chat is never sent to Claude.

follow.description: Whether pages move to a new round when it arrives.
